markets.name: freelance-design
markets.summary: Freelancers design logos, brands, websites, apps and illustrations.
markets.description: Work is delivered remotely; pay piece by piece, each piece once delivered, so neither side risks much.

markets.name: freelance-software
markets.summary: Freelancers build and fix software, delivered remotely.
markets.description: Pay piece by piece, each piece once delivered, so neither side risks much.

markets.name: freelance-video
markets.summary: Freelancers edit videos and make animations and motion graphics.
markets.description: Work is delivered remotely, with no filming at events; pay piece by piece, each piece once delivered, so neither side risks much.

markets.name: goods
markets.summary: People sell everyday things, new or used.
markets.description: Things are handed over and paid in person, or shipped when the price is one either side could lose; not motor vehicles or homes.

markets.name: home-cleaning
markets.description: Cleaners are paid by the visit, and often come every week.

markets.name: home-repair
markets.summary: Repairers do plumbing, electrical and handyman jobs in people's homes.
markets.description: Each job is paid once it is done; not renovations paid in stages.

markets.name: language-exchange
markets.summary: Two people practise each other's language, taking turns.
markets.description: Partners meet online or in person, with no money between them. For adults.

markets.name: sports-coaching
markets.summary: Coaches teach a sport or fitness, one on one or in groups.
markets.description: Coaching is in person or online, paid by the session or the hour; the student is whoever arranges the coaching, often a parent, who stays present for a child's session in person.

markets.name: stays-free
markets.summary: Hosts give guests a couch or a room for free.
markets.description: Hosts ask only for good company: no tasks and no money between them. For adults.

markets.name: stays-work
markets.summary: Hosts give guests a bed, and often meals, for their help.
markets.description: Guests help on a farm or in a hostel, with building, or by sitting a house or pets, with no money between them. For adults.

markets.name: tours
markets.summary: Local guides show a group around, paid on the day.
markets.description: The tour may be a food, walking, history or nature tour, or any other kind. For adults.

markets.name: tutoring
markets.summary: Tutors teach school subjects, languages, chess and other desk subjects.
markets.description: Lessons are online or in person, paid by the lesson or the hour; the student is whoever arranges the lessons, often a parent, who stays present for a child's lesson in person.
